cards.english_title: The World Enters an Age of Climate Extremes
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 11월 9일 구테흐스가 안탈리아에서 경고했다. WMO는 2026년 세계 고온이 계속됐다고 말했다. 1월부터 9월까지 기온은 1.47도 높았다. WMO는 강한 엘니뇨가 2027년까지 더위를 부를 수 있다고 했다.
cards.english_desc: On November 9, 2026, Antonio Guterres warned COP31 leaders in Antalya. The WMO said 2026 continued a streak of exceptional global heat. January-to-September temperatures averaged 1.47 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. The WMO said strong El Niño could bring more heat through 2027.
cards.hook: Climate extremes are becoming the new normal.
cards.takeaway_english: COP31 faces pressure to turn alarming measurements into practical protection.
cards.takeaway_korean: COP31은 경고를 실제 보호로 바꿔야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: Hotter conditions can intensify heatwaves, storms and heavy rain.
why_it_matters.korean: 더위는 폭염과 폭풍을 강하게 만들 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Sea-level rise and melting ice affect homes, food and water.
why_it_matters.korean: 해수면 상승은 집과 식량에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Early warnings can help people prepare before dangerous weather arrives.

parties.label: Antonio Guterres
parties.english: The UN chief urged COP31 leaders to cut emissions and fund protection.
parties.korean: 구테흐스는 배출 감축과 보호 자금을 촉구했다.

parties.label: World Meteorological Organization
parties.english: The WMO reported record heat, melting ice and rising seas.

parties.label: Vulnerable countries
parties.english: They need finance, protection and working early-warning systems.

views.label: UN and WMO
views.english: Leaders must cut emissions faster because extreme weather is intensifying beyond old expectations.

views.label: Climate negotiators
views.english: Early-warning systems are improving, but they need sustained investment and global cooperation.

disagree.english: Some may argue that adaptation systems deserve equal attention alongside emissions cuts.
disagree.korean: 일부는 배출 감축과 적응이 똑같이 중요하다고 본다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 부유한 나라는 기후 보호비를 더 내야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Russia Strikes Ukraine’s Power System and a Black Sea Vessel
cards.korean_desc: 11월 9일 러시아가 우크라이나 변전소 세 곳과 흑해 화물선을 공격했다. 러시아는 선박이 우크라이나 무기를 실었다고 말했다. IEA는 반복 공격이 우크라이나 겨울 전력을 위협한다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: On November 9, Russia struck three Ukrainian power substations and a Black Sea cargo ship. Russia said the ship was carrying arms for Ukraine. The IEA says repeated strikes threaten Ukraine’s winter electricity supply.
cards.hook: Russia hit Ukraine’s power system and a ship.
cards.takeaway_english: The strikes show how the war is pressing both infrastructure and shipping routes.
cards.takeaway_korean: 공격은 전쟁이 기반시설과 항로를 압박함을 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: Power strikes can affect heating, water systems and daily life.
why_it_matters.korean: 전력 공격은 난방과 물 공급을 흔든다.

why_it_matters.english: Attacks on ships can threaten food, trade and maritime workers.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: Russia said its overnight strikes hit Ukrainian power substations and vessels.
parties.korean: 러시아는 우크라이나 변전소와 선박을 공격했다고 말했다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: Ukraine faces continuing pressure on electricity infrastructure before winter.
parties.korean: 우크라이나는 겨울 전력 압박을 받고 있다.

parties.label: Black Sea shipping
parties.english: Commercial vessels face growing danger as attacks spread around the region.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Moscow said the targets supported Ukraine’s defense industry or carried military goods.
views.korean: 모스크바는 표적이 우크라이나 군수산업을 도왔다고 말했다.

views.label: Ukraine and outside analysts
views.english: Ukraine’s energy system has faced repeated attacks that threaten winter electricity supplies.
views.korean: 우크라이나 전력망은 반복 공격으로 겨울 공급이 위협받는다.

disagree.english: Russia’s claims about cargo and military links were not independently confirmed in the available coverage.
disagree.korean: 선박의 군사 관련 주장은 독립적으로 확인되지 않았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 전쟁 중 민간 전력망을 어떻게 지켜야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Sheikh Hasina Seeks a New Passport From Bangladesh
cards.korean_desc: 11월 9일 하시나가 뉴델리 방글라데시 공관에 새 여권을 요청했다. 그녀의 옛 여권은 2024년 8월 탈출 뒤 취소됐다. 런던 법률회사가 요청했고 방글라데시는 내용을 확인 중이다. 외교부는 내부 협의 뒤 결정할 예정이다.
cards.english_desc: On November 9, Sheikh Hasina requested a new passport from Bangladesh’s mission in New Delhi. Her old passport was cancelled after she fled Bangladesh in August 2024. A London law firm sent the request, and Bangladesh is checking its contents. The ministry will decide after internal consultation.
cards.hook: Sheikh Hasina wants a new passport after exile.
cards.korean_hook: 하시나가 망명 뒤 새 여권을 원한다
cards.takeaway_english: The passport decision may reveal whether Hasina’s return plan is becoming practical.
cards.takeaway_korean: 여권 결정은 귀국 계획의 현실성을 보여줄 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The decision could affect Bangladesh’s politics and relations with India.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 방글라데시 정치와 인도 관계에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Hasina faces a death sentence from a tribunal criticized for limited legal representation.
why_it_matters.korean: 하시나는 법적 대표가 없었다는 비판을 받은 재판에서 사형을 선고받았다.

parties.label: Sheikh Hasina
parties.english: The former prime minister requested a new passport and may return to Bangladesh.
parties.korean: 전 총리는 새 여권을 요청했고 귀국할 수 있다.

parties.label: Bangladesh Foreign Ministry
parties.english: The ministry is checking the request before deciding.
parties.korean: 외교부는 결정 전에 요청을 확인하고 있다.

parties.label: Awami League
parties.english: Party leaders in India have repeatedly said Hasina plans to return.
parties.korean: 인도에 있는 당 지도자들은 귀국 계획을 말했다.

views.label: Bangladesh authorities
views.english: The request needs internal consultation because Hasina’s passport was cancelled after she fled in 2024.

views.label: Hasina’s legal team
views.english: The lawyers seek documents that could support her return from India.

disagree.english: Critics may say a passport request does not prove that Hasina will actually return.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 여권 요청이 귀국 증거는 아니라고 말할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Krakow Shooting Suspect Dies After Six People Are Killed
cards.korean_desc: 11월 7일 24세 폴란드 남성이 크라쿠프 중심에서 사람들을 쐈다. 6명이 숨졌고 경찰은 총격전에서 용의자를 다치게 했다. 검찰은 공격을 테러 사건으로 수사하기 시작했다.
cards.english_desc: On November 7, a 24-year-old Polish man shot people in central Krakow. Six people died, and police wounded the suspect during a shootout. Prosecutors opened a terrorism investigation into the attack.
cards.hook: The Krakow shooting suspect died in hospital.
cards.takeaway_english: The suspect’s death ends one part of the case, but investigations continue.

why_it_matters.english: The attack killed and wounded people in a busy public square.
why_it_matters.korean: 공격은 붐비는 광장에서 사람을 죽이고 다치게 했다.

parties.label: The suspect
parties.english: The 24-year-old Polish man died after police wounded him.
parties.korean: 24세 폴란드 남성은 경찰 총격 뒤 숨졌다.

parties.label: Victims and survivors
parties.english: Six people were killed and 15 were wounded in Krakow.

parties.label: Polish authorities
parties.english: Authorities opened a terrorism investigation into the shooting.

views.label: Polish police
views.english: Police said the suspect died in hospital on November 9.

views.label: Prosecutors
views.english: Prosecutors are investigating the killings and attempted murders as terrorism.

disagree.english: The suspect’s motive and the full circumstances remain under investigation.
disagree.korean: 용의자의 동기와 전체 경위는 아직 조사 중이다.

cards.english_title: Greece Recovers 12 Dead Migrants From a Boat Near Crete
cards.korean_desc: 리비아 북동부에서 크레타로 오는 사람은 급증했다. 화물선이 해안에서 약 15해리 떨어진 곳에서 18명을 구조했다. 그리스 당국은 전체 도착은 줄었지만 크레타 해상 이동은 늘었다고 했다.
cards.english_desc: Arrivals from northeastern Libya to Crete have surged. A cargo ship rescued 18 people about 15 nautical miles offshore. Greek authorities said patrols reduced arrivals overall, but Crete saw more sea crossings.
cards.hook: Greece recovered 12 bodies from a migrant boat.
cards.takeaway_english: Crete’s rising arrivals keep Europe’s migration and rescue challenge in view.
cards.takeaway_korean: 크레타의 도착 증가는 유럽의 구조 문제를 드러낸다.

why_it_matters.english: Deaths at sea show the human cost of migration routes to Europe.
why_it_matters.korean: 바다의 사망은 유럽행 이주의 대가를 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: Rescue teams must respond across a large and dangerous sea area.
why_it_matters.korean: 구조대는 넓고 위험한 바다에서 대응해야 한다.

parties.label: The migrants
parties.english: Twelve people died, while 18 others from the boat were rescued.

parties.label: Greek Coast Guard
parties.english: The coast guard led rescue operations south of Crete.

parties.label: Migrants traveling from Libya
parties.english: Sea arrivals from northeastern Libya to Crete have surged.
parties.korean: 리비아 북동부에서 크레타로 오는 해상 도착이 늘었다.

views.label: Greek authorities
views.english: More patrols reduced some arrivals, but boats from Libya are now reaching Crete more often.
views.korean: 순찰은 일부 도착을 줄였지만 리비아발 배는 늘었다.

views.label: Humanitarian perspective
views.english: The deaths show the continuing danger of sea routes used by migrants seeking Europe.
views.korean: 사망은 유럽행 해상 경로의 위험을 보여준다.

disagree.english: The available coverage does not identify the migrants’ nationalities or explain why the boat sank.
disagree.korean: 보도에는 이주민 국적과 침몰 원인이 없다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 위험한 바다 여행을 줄이려면 무엇이 필요할까요?

cards.english_title: Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. Return to Peace Talks
cards.korean_desc: 러시아·우크라이나·미국 협상단이 11월 10~11일 아부다비에서 만난다. 회담은 우크라이나와 유럽의 안보 보장에 집중한다. 이전 지역 휴전에도 1,200킬로미터 전선에서 전투가 계속된다. 러시아와 우크라이나는 영토·나토·군사 제한에서 여전히 다르다.
cards.english_desc: Russian, Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators will meet in Abu Dhabi on November 10–11. The talks will focus on security guarantees for Ukraine and Europe. Fighting continues along a 1,200-kilometre front line despite earlier local truces. Russia and Ukraine still disagree over territory, NATO and military limits.
cards.hook: Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. meet in Abu Dhabi.
cards.takeaway_english: The Abu Dhabi meeting opens diplomacy, but the central demands remain sharply opposed.
cards.takeaway_korean: 아부다비 회담은 외교를 열지만 핵심 요구는 맞선다.

why_it_matters.english: Security guarantees could shape whether fighting returns after any agreement.
why_it_matters.korean: 안보 보장은 협정 뒤 전투 재개를 좌우할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The talks may affect Ukraine, Russia and wider European security.
why_it_matters.korean: 회담은 우크라이나와 러시아, 유럽 안보에 영향을 준다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: Russia wants territory, military limits and wider European security guarantees.
parties.korean: 러시아는 영토와 군사 제한, 유럽 안보 보장을 원한다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: Ukraine rejects giving up territory and wants security guarantees before a lasting settlement.
parties.korean: 우크라이나는 영토 포기를 거부하고 안보 보장을 원한다.

parties.label: United States
parties.english: The United States is mediating talks scheduled for Abu Dhabi.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Moscow says a full peace deal should address Russia’s security concerns and not merely pause fighting.
views.korean: 모스크바는 평화협정이 러시아 안보 우려도 다뤄야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: Ukraine and European allies
views.english: Kyiv wants an immediate ceasefire and Europe included in decisions about European security.
views.korean: 키이우는 즉시 휴전과 유럽의 참여를 원한다.

disagree.english: The sides remain far apart on territory, NATO, military limits and who should guarantee peace.
disagree.korean: 양측은 영토와 나토, 군사 제한, 보장국에서 크게 다르다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 휴전과 평화협정 중 무엇이 먼저여야 할까요?
